description: How much this tenant can actually send: combined warm-up-aware daily cap, capacity remaining today, the earliest the pacing engine could release the first message, and — when you pass audience_size — how many days the audience takes to drain at that rate. Call this before queueing anything large. ⚠️ provider_configured=false means nothing can leave yet regardless of capacity.

audience_size.description: Audience size to compute a drain estimate for (default: 0).

mailbox_ids.description: Restrict to these sources. Omitted = every source the tenant owns.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_get_capacity
